programme.title: El Extraño Amor de Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Una joven que trata de huir de su tía, la empuja escaleras abajo y fallece, siendo testigos Sam y Walter.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India precipita a un grupo de jóvenes urbanos a cuestionar sus relaciones y sexualidad.

programme.title: Villa Bella
programme.desc: Tres mujeres de diferentes caminos se unen como cuidadoras en un hogar de ancianos y encuentran amistad.

programme.title: Freaked
programme.desc: Un actor vanidoso, su mejor amigo y un activista terminan en una granja de monstruos mutantes dirigida por un científico raro.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert, un banquero excesivamente preocupado por el éxito, tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama, después de que él le proponga matrimonio y ella le rechace si antes no cambia de aires.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India precipita a un grupo de jóvenes urbanos a cuestionar sus relaciones y sexualidad.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Matar a Mamá?
programme.desc: Tres hermanas que no se llevan bien con su madre se enfrentan a la noticia de que ella está enferma y la acompañarán en el último viaje de su vida. Ella les pide que la ayuden a dejar este mundo que pondrá en conflicto a las hermanas durante el viaje.

programme.title: Seis Días Corrientes
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de una semana en la vida de Valero, Moha y Pep, trabajadores de una pequeña empresa de fontanería y electricidad en las afueras de Barcelona. Bajo una capa de humor, ligereza y cotidianidad, las historias ofrecen elementos de reflexión más profunda.

programme.title: Aliança Mortal
programme.desc: No coração de uma floresta na fronteira entre os EUA e o Canadá, dois inimigos precisam trabalhar juntos para escapar de um cartel de drogas implacável, determinado a recuperar um carregamento de drogas que desapareceu no local.

programme.title: Retornados
programme.desc: La humanidad convive con los "Retornados", personas de aspecto normal que han sido infectadas por un virus devastador. Sólo la inyección diaria de una proteína impide que se conviertan en zombis. Kate trabaja en una unidad de investigación que intenta encontrar urgentemente una vacuna definitiva para detener la propagación de la epidemia. También oculta una poderosa razón: su compañero, Alex, es un "devuelto".

programme.title: Luta Pela Liberdade
programme.desc: No estado de Manchukuo, nos anos 30, quatro agentes especiais do Partido Comunista, após retornarem à China, embarcam em uma missão secreta. Exausta por um traidor, a equipe se vê rodeada de correção de todos os lados.

programme.title: La diligencia: La historia de Texas Jack
programme.desc: El ex ladrón de diligencias, Nathaniel Reed inicia una nueva vida honesta junto su esposa Laura Lee. Pero ésta se interrumpe cuando su viejo compañero, Frank Bell, aparece para informar a Reed que lo quieren matar. Tras un tiroteo en el que supuestamente muere su esposa Laura, Reed huye con Bell y Sid Dalton, convirtiéndose en los forajidos más buscados.

programme.title: Infiltrado
programme.desc: Ao perceber que suas chances de escapar do cerco da polícia eram mínimas, um perigoso bandido decide atirar em si próprio para forçar os oficiais a cessarem fogo e levá-lo ao hospital. Ao receber atendimento, o criminoso usa os direitos humanos como desculpa para recusar tratamento para seu ferimento, ganhando tempo para que seus comparsas se organizem para resgatá-lo. - Enxergando a real intenção do criminoso, o detetive responsável pela operação decide não intervir e adota uma estratégia perigosa: deixar todo o bando entrar no hospital para assim efetuar uma só prisão e desarticular toda a rede criminosa de uma só vez. O problema é que há toda a equipe de médicos e muitos pacientes no local e muitas vidas estarão em risco se algo der errado.

programme.title: October Gale
programme.desc: Una doctora invita en su casa a un hombre misterioso en su remota cabaña con una herida de bala.

programme.title: Tráfico de Mulheres
programme.desc: Nesta história inspirada em personagens reais, três garotas dos EUA, Nigéria e Índia são traficadas por meio de uma elaborada rede global e escravizadas em um bordel no Texas, e devem juntas tentar uma fuga ousada para retomar sua liberdade.

programme.title: Black Rose
programme.desc: El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles contrata a un comandante de la policía rusa para ayudar a resolver una serie de horribles asesinatos perpetrados contra mujeres jóvenes por un sádico asesino sociópata en las calles de Hollywood.

programme.title: A Família
programme.desc: Um chefe mafioso e sua família são transferidos para uma cidade dorminhoca na França, sob o programa de proteção de testemunhas, depois de denunciar a máfia.

programme.title: Dirty Lies
programme.desc: La desaparición de un collar de un millón de dólares pone patas arriba la vida de un joven asistente. Debe averiguar en tiempo récord quién de sus compañeros le ha traicionado. Además, su vida corre peligro porque unos criminales persiguen también la codiciada joya. Y el tiempo se acaba.

programme.title: Inquebrantable
programme.desc: La historia del atleta olímpico Eric Liddell, quien fue prisionero de guerra en China durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Bastardos e Armados
programme.desc: Preso em uma prisão argelina, o mercenário Sergio recebe uma oferta de um misterioso gângster: sua liberdade pode ser negociada com o governo local, desde que ele cumpra a missão de recuperar certos documentos escondidos em uma vila perto de Roma. Mas a situação se complica com a chegada de Caligola, o mentor, evoluindo em uma espiral de crescente tensão e violência.

programme.title: Los Chicos de Scottsboro
programme.desc: En 1931, un abogado defensor de Nueva York (Timothy Hutton) acude en ayuda de nueve hombres negros acusados ​​de violar a dos mujeres blancas en el sur.

programme.title: 6 Balas
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um lutador de MMA é sequestrada, há somente um homem que pode ajudar a encontrá-la – um notório ex-mercenário, cujo boatos, levou seis tiros no peito.

programme.title: Retornados

programme.title: A Verdadeira História de Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Inspirado no best-seller de Peter Carey, este filme coloca em questão toda a mitologia criada ao redor do mito sobre a vida de Ned Kelly, observando o passado de violência de toda uma sociedade. Acompanhamos a juventude de Ned e observamos sua vida até o final, percebendo, sob a ótica do protagonista, o quanto é distorcida a fina linha que separa o certo do errado. As motivações de Kelly são reveladas e as tragédias em torno de sua gangue são mostradas de forma intensa e poderosa, a começar pelo amor de uma mãe por seu filho.

programme.title: Uri - Fuerzas Especiales
programme.desc: Las fuerzas especiales del ejército indio ejecutan una operación encubierta, vengando el asesinato de compañeros del ejército en su base por parte de un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: Accion Legal
programme.desc: Un abogado descubre la gran corrupción del pequeño pueblo en el jucio a su ex cuñado, acusado de asesinar a un fiscal del distrito local.

programme.title: Apocalipsis en Los Ángeles
programme.desc: Se detecta actividad volcánica en el núcleo de la Tierra y los científicos descubren que la ciudad de Los Ángeles está a punto de ser borrada del mapa. Mientras el área es evacuada, un hombre vuelve a la ciudad para encontrar a su novia, pero descubre que ha sido secuestrada.

programme.title: Fuerza Polar
programme.desc: Un cometa impacta contra la Tierra causando diversas catástrofes naturales.

programme.title: Los Signos Del Apocalipsis
programme.desc: Cuando un misterioso planeta atraviesa el sol, se desatan catástrofes globales. Un solitario científico es la clave para descifrar los símbolos y la única oportunidad de la humanidad de sobrevivir.

programme.title: Origins of the Universe: The Great Debate
programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. Durante muchos años ha habido un acalorado debate entre evolución y creación, con la pregunta central de todo: "¿Fue creada la Tierra o llegó a existir por sí sola?" Conozca a siete expertos en sus campos que han dedicado su vida al estudio de esta cuestión.

programme.title: Fuerza Polar
programme.desc: Un cometa impacta contra la Tierra causando diversas catástrofes naturales.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Patricia y Lorenzo formalizan su matrimonio gracias a la intervención de Manolo. Luciano logra desviar la investigación que se inició en su contra levantando cargos hacia Fernán Benítez.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: El director del noticiero decide no involucrarse en los asuntos de El Bronx, lo que deja desprotegida a Judith. A raíz de una traición, Caracha es el nuevo jefe de la zona de San Bernardo.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Después de incumplir el trato para liberar a Juliana ​queda demostrado que la ambición de Manolo por el dinero es mucho más grande de lo que se cree. Marucha será víctima de una injusticia.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Fierro intenta desviar la investigación de la desaparición de Neira. En El Bronx se desata una pelea por la imprudencia de Gerardo, este enfrentamiento cobrará una vida.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Fierro tendrá que asumir las consecuencias de sus acciones, ahora como prófugo de la justicia. La llegada de Fernando a las calles de El Bronx cambiará los planes de Andrés y Manolo.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Manolo manipula la situación para sacar a Juliana de la vida de Andrés y que este último pueda concentrarse en la música. La desaparición de Marucha es un enigma que Andrés debe resolver.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Desarticular la banda de delincuentes liderada por Manolo pone en riesgo el cargo de Andrade en la institución. Todos los enemigos de Manolo se unen para acabar con su imperio.

programme.title: Historias Para No Dormir
programme.desc: El día de su 50 cumpleaños, un hombre planea matar a su esposa y robar el banco para el que trabaja.

programme.title: Mia y el león blanco
programme.desc: Mia se muda a Sudáfrica con su familia para hacerse cargo de una granja de leones y allí desarrolla un vínculo especial con Charlie, un cachorro blanco. Sin embargo, todo cambia cuando descubre el secreto de su padre.

programme.title: Escucha a tu Corazón
programme.desc: Un cantante y compositor se enamora de una chica que no puede oír la música que ella le inspira a escribir.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en quienes más confiaba, un sicario novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y comienza un juego despiadado de matar primero o ser asesinado.

programme.title: O Inimaginável
programme.desc: Um pianista deve voltar para sua aldeia no interior da Suécia para organizar o funeral de sua mãe. Lá, ele terá que lidar com o que ficou para trás, família e amores, enquanto o país segue sob misteriosos ataques.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo llamado Thomas y dos adorables hijos. Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: Imortais
programme.desc: Grécia, 1228 A.C. O rei Hiperion está em busca do arco de Épiro, uma poderosa arma que pode matar até mesmo deuses. Para encontrá-lo ele conduz seu exército a todos os vilarejos, deixando um rastro de destruição.

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: A pesar de que lo esperaban, la madrugada en que su madre falleció, el mundo de Vega se cubrió con un manto de tristeza bajo el que solamente podría distinguir la mirada desordenada y afligida de su padre. Y en los más oscuro de su desconcierto conoció a Nico, un pintor callejero que llenó su universo de color a pinceladas de ternura, amor y libertad

programme.title: Um Encontro com o Destino
programme.desc: Depois de saber que ela foi incumbida de cuidar dos filhos de seu primo falecido, uma arquiteta fica dividida entre se concentrar em sua carreira e honrar o desejo de seu primo.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: Carlos, príncipe de una corona centroeuropea, llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso. María, que trabaja en la clínica veterinaria de su padre, conoce a Carlos por casualidad. Los dos ocultan su verdadera identidad y establecen una relación muy especial. Pronto se descubren sus mentiras mutuas. Carlos descubre que María tiene una hija y María se entera de la condición principesca de Carlos por unas fotos publicadas en la prensa sensacionalista.

programme.title: Amor em Rítmo de Dança
programme.desc: 2002: Jake Mitchell é o atual campeão mundial de West Coast Swing. Ele tem tudo a seu favor: boa aparência, personalidade e estilo. Ele está no auge de sua carreira quando ele e sua parceira, Corinne, são coroados os vencedores inesperados do Campeonato Mundial de Dança Swing. Enquanto a multidão vibra e a celebração começa, Jake parece inquieto. Será que ele realmente merecia ganhar?

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan al ficticio Sangyoon para la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde. Eddie y Paige ayudan, pero encuentran problemas y un elefante real; Sin embargo, aún así, el amor verdadero prevalece.

programme.title: A Árvore Da Vida
programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos quedan atrapados en un bucle temporal durante una boda en Palm Springs, viviendo el mismo día una y otra vez.

programme.title: La gran enfermedad del amor
programme.desc: Comedia romántica nominada al Oscar a Mejor Guion Original. Kumail y Emily son una pareja que se conoce en un espectáculo de comedia. A pesar de sus diferencias culturales, su relación empieza a avanzar, complicando las vidas de todos por las expectativas de los estrictos padres de Kumail.

programme.title: Suite Francesa
programme.desc: França, 1940. Enquanto espera por notícias do marido, um prisioneiro de guerra, a bela Lucile leva uma vida reprimida com sua sogra controladora. Mas em breve, um regimento de soldados germânicos instalados nas casas dos camponeses. No inicio, Lucile tenta ignorar Bruno, o refinado oficial alemão que estava com elas, mas depois, um amor forte atrai-los e leva-os a tragédia da guerra.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras Mujeres
programme.desc: En una boda en un hotel de Nueva York, un hombre y una mujer de unos cuarenta años se conocen y entablan una ingeniosa conversación llena de dobles sentidos. Ella fuma continuamente y él bebe sin cesar, mientras ambos despliegan sus estrategias para acercarse. Ella, con su acento británico y su habilidad para mantener a los hombres a distancia, atrae su atención con sus ocurrencias. Él, por su parte, utiliza múltiples tácticas para asediarla, resultando finalmente irresistible.

programme.title: Terapia do Sexo
programme.desc: Uma comédia romântica que reúne três personagens distintos que aprendem a enfrentar um mundo desafiador e muitas vezes confuso enquanto lutam juntos contra um demônio em comum: o vício em sexo.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo

Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: De Amor e Trevas
programme.desc: A história do escritor Amos Oz, nascido na Palestina e criado no período pós-guerra por um pai apaixonado por literatura e uma mãe polonesa que fugiu do antissemitismo. Amos Oz buscou um acordo de paz entre Israel e a Palestina.

programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Don't Breathe
programme.desc: Pour échapper à la violence de sa mère et sauver sa jeune sœur d'une existence sans avenir, Rocky est prête à tout. Avec ses amis Alex et Money, elle a déjà commis quelques cambriolages, mais rien qui leur rapporte assez pour enfin quitter Détroit. Lorsque le trio entend parler d'un aveugle qui vit en solitaire et garde chez lui une petite fortune, ils préparent ce qu'ils pensent être leur ultime coup. Mais leur victime va se révéler bien plus effrayante, et surtout bien plus dangereuse que ce à quoi ils s'attendaient…

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2
programme.desc: Quelques années après l'effraction mortelle au domicile de Norman Nordstrom (Stephen Lang), ce dernier vit toujours dans la maison délabrée de Détroit mais cette fois avec une adolescente nommée Phoenix.

programme.title: Art Of Steal
programme.desc: Deux frères spécialisés dans le vol d'oeuvres d'art décident d'orchestrer un dernier cambriolage. Mais les choses ne se passent pas tout à fait comme prévu...

programme.title: Flatliners (1990)
programme.desc: Nelson Wright, brillant étudiant en médecine, réussit à convaincre quelques-uns de ses condisciples de l'aider à provoquer son propre arrêt cardiaque pour atteindre un au-delà qui, croit-il, pourrait lui donner quelques réponses sur la mort, et donc sur la vie.

programme.title: Traque Sur Internet
programme.desc: Angela Bennett, une jeune analyste du reseau Internet, va se retrouver malgré elle au coeur d'un réseau de terrorisme informatique.

programme.title: Anacondas - À la poursuite de l'orchidée de sang
programme.desc: Un groupe de scientifiques décide de s'embarquer dans un voyage périlleux à la recherche d'une orchidée très rare qui pourrait détenir un sérum pour préserver la jeunesse. Mais l'expédition s'avère bien plus périlleuse que prévue. De redoutables prédateurs protègent l'orchidée et son terrible secret.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen) est un fainéant le jour, et fêtard la nuit… jusqu'à ce qu'il trouve une carrière qui est trop cool : héros justicier. Dans la peau du Frelon vert, il s'associe avec le bricoleur de génie et expert en arts martiaux, Kato (Jay Chou) pour éliminer la pègre de Los Angeles. Même l'assistante de Britt, Leonore (Cameron Diaz), ne soupçonne pas que cette paire mal assortie est le duo masqué arrêtant les voyous les plus durs de la ville, menés par Chudnofsky (Christopher Waltz, gagnant de l'Oscar® du meilleur acteur dans un second rôle pour Inglourious Basterds). Avec style, arrogance et des gadgets géniaux, le Frelon vert et Kato rendent justice à leur manière, faisant de chaque mission un mélange d'action exagérée et de comédie extravagante.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Une tempête effroyable se dechaîne sur le Pacifique, engloutissant un pétrolier tandis qu'un immense éclair illumine le ciel au-dessus de la Polynésie française. Des empreintes géantes creusent un inquiétant sillon à travers des milliers de kilomètres de forêts et de plages au Panama.

programme.title: Le Masque de Zorro
programme.desc: Après ving ans de prison, Don Diego de La Vega, alias Zorro, qui a autrefois combattu avec succès l'oppression espagnole et qui est toujours poursuivi par la haine du gouverneur Rafael Montero, se cherche un successeur. Il rencontre alors un jeune brigand, Alejandro Murieta, qui a lui aussi quelques comptes à régler avec l'ancien gouverneur. Après une formation complète, de La Vega remet à son élève le masque de Zorro, son épée et son fouet et l'envoie déjouer le sinistre complot de Montero visant à confisquer la Californie au Mexique.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: L'histoire de la naissance du personnage le plus énigmatique, complexe et badass de l'univers Marvel : VENOM ! Après avoir tout perdu, notamment sa femme et son travail, Eddy Brock (Tom Hardy) est un homme complètement abattu. Alors qu'il est au plus bas, il devient l'hôte d'un symbiote alien qui lui confère d'extraordinaires superpouvoirs et le transforme progressivement en Venom... Mais ces nouveaux pouvoirs ne vont peut être pas suffire face au redoutable Riot, un autre symbiote bien plus puissant et armé que lui…

programme.title: Nightmare Island
programme.desc: Dans NIGHTMARE ISLAND (Blumhouse), l’énigmatique M. Roarke (Michael Peña) donne vie aux rêves de ses clients dans un complexe hôtelier luxurieux et isolé. Mais quand leurs fantasmes les plus fous se transforment en véritables cauchemars, les invités n’ont d’autre choix que de résoudre les mystères de cette île pour espérer en sortir vivants…

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Jenko et Schmidt quittent le lycée et s'engagent dans la police. A la suite de leur première arrestation ratée, les deux jeunes policiers sont convoqués par leur supérieur. Celui-ci leur annonce qu'ils sont mutés dans une cellule des années 80 récemment réactivée, l'unité «21 Jump Street». Dans une église désaffectée, Jenko et Schmidt rencontrent d'autres jeunes policiers. Tous ont été choisis pour infiltrer les milieux universitaires californiens en tant qu'étudiants. Leur objectif est de démanteler les réseaux de trafiquants de drogue. Ces recrues sont soumises à des règles précises : pas de relations avec les élèves et les enseignants, et pas d'achat d'alcool à leur place. Jenko et Schmidt tente de mener l'enquête, mais n'en font qu'à leur tête...

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Un jeune homme pressé d’être père confond un jeune garçon qu’il doit adopter avec un criminel en fuite qui a la particularité d’avoir un visage poupin et d’être de petite taille. Mais ce dernier se rend vite compte qu’il vaut mieux avoir les flics aux fesses plutôt que des couches !

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Un cadre et un joueur de baseball professionnel se disputent l'affection de la même femme.

programme.title: Chair De Poule
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon déménage avec sa mère et sa soeur dans la petite ville de Greendale, dans le Maryland. Sur place, il rencontre l'écrivain RL Stine, auteur à succès de romans d'épouvante pour adolescents…

programme.title: Chair de Poule 2
programme.desc: Ne soyez pas trop curieux ! Pour préparer la brocante de l'école, deux meilleurs amis : Sonny et Sam, sont en quête de trésors qu'auraient précipitamment abandonnés les gens dans leurs ordures. Mais après avoir passé au crible la vielle maison de M. Stine, ils ouvrent un livre jusqu'à lors scellé qui libère un cauchemar surnaturel : Slappy ! Une course contre la montre s'engage alors, avec l'aide de Sarah la sœur de Sonny, ils vont tout mettre en œuvre pour tenter de ramener le Pantin maléfique et tous les monstres qu'il a ressuscité à l'intérieur du livre, avant qu'il ne répande un chaos total...

programme.title: Comme Au Bon Vieux Temps
programme.desc: Alors qu'il peine sur un roman dans sa retraite au bord de l'océan, l'écrivain Nick Gardenia est enlevé par deux escrocs qui l'obligent à cambrioler une banque pour leur compte. En proie à ses difficultés, Nick n'a personne vers qui se tourner pour lui venir en aide, si ce n'est Glenda, son ex-femme. Parce qu'elle se laisse facilement attendrir par les âmes égarées, elle le prend chez elle.

programme.title: Premiers Pas Dans La Mafia
programme.desc: A peine arrivé à New York, Clark Kellogg, jeune étudiant en cinéma, se fait détrousser par un faux chauffeur de taxi. Mais cet incident l'amène à rencontrer Carmine Sabatini, mafieux sosie du Parrain, qui lui confie une mission insolite : transporter un mystérieux colis destiné à une assemblée secrète de gourmets...

programme.title: Animal L'animal
programme.desc: Marvin est un véritable loser et le bouc émissaire de ses collègues policiers. Après avoir été victime d'un terrible accident de voiture, il est soigné par un savant qui lui greffe des organes d'animaux : si cela lui permet de sentir la drogue et de sauver le fils du maire de la noyade, il lui est de plus en plus difficile de se contrôler.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick rêve d'un rendez-vous avec Suzanne, mais elle ne souhaite que son amitié. Lorsqu'elle se trouve coincée à cause de son travail, il lui propose de lui amener ses enfants à Vancouver pour le réveillon. Mais pour eux, aucun homme n'est assez bien pour leur mère, et ils sont capables de tout.

programme.title: Hitch Expert En Séduction
programme.desc: A New York, Hitch exerce une activité aussi originale que secrète : il aide les plus timides à conquérir la femme de leur vie. Son dernier client, Albert, un comptable, est tombé éperdument amoureux de la célèbre Allegra Cole. En guidant Albert vers le bonheur, Hitch rencontre Sara Melas, une journaliste people qui suit Allegra comme une ombre. Pour Hitch, c'est le coup de foudre, mais les conseils qu'il donne aux autres ne lui suffiront pas forcément, d'autant que la journaliste rêve de démasquer le mystérieux conseiller en séduction dont toute la ville parle…

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Que faire quand on est les deux agents les plus nuls du FBI, qu’on est chargé d’escorter deux bimbos blondes menacées d’enlèvement, mais qu’on a un accident ? Prendre la place des deux minettes pour la soirée top-fashion de l’année !

programme.title: Good Luck Chuck
programme.desc: La superstar de Hollywood Jessica Alba (Fantastic Four, Into The Blue) et le comique Dane Cook tiennent la vedette dans cette comédie romantique désopilante. Un homme qui a rompu avec celle qui fut longtemps sa petite amie est surpris d'apprendre qu'elle a décidé de se fiancer avec celui qu'elle vient de rencontrer. Il répète le modèle et des célibataires commencent à le fréquenter dans l'espoir de trouver M. Parfait.

programme.title: Sony One | Séries Comédie
programme.desc: Séries de comédies à mourir de rire pour une expérience relax et enjouée parfaite à partager en famille et avec des amis.

programme.title: Sony One | Séries Thriller

programme.desc: Ramsay heads to Starkville, Miss., to help David and Sukie revamp their formerly thriving business, Hotel Chester.

programme.desc: Gordon goes to La Parra de Burriana in Costa del Sol, Spain, to try and save the restaurant run by a former nightclub manager.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The Fenwick Arms pub is run by landlord Brian who puts in 120 hours a week and insists on laying down the law in the kitchen.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon finds a chef caught in a time warp when he tackles a largely unfrequented upmarket restaurant in King's Lynn.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon comes to the aid of former actor Allan Love, whose restaurant Ruby Tate's is losing money due to his lack of control and apathetic chefs.

programme.title: Plastic Surgery Knifemares
programme.desc: A firsthand account of so-called "Botox Parties."

programme.title: Plastic Surgery Knifemares
programme.desc: Uncovering the secrets behind dermal lip fillers and how social media and celebrities have driven a boom in the industry.

programme.title: Gordon's Great Escape

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Extreme Weather Countdown
programme.sub-title: Extreme Weather Countdown | Dust Devils in the Wind
programme.desc: Weather is an unrelenting force, tearing through our lives and homes, with no regard for the human condition. But lucky for us, these humans have been conditioned to take out their phones and record whatever is happening, letting us relive the experiences again and again. And when it comes to weather that is out of the ordinary, that's truly where we come alive. Strap in, because you're about to get hit by an Extreme Weather Countdown.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris and Casey have hiked across New Zealand for weeks. Fighting for their lives has taken a toll on their emotions and abilities. They team up to hunt feral pigs, but the cache items used for survival create new challenges and deep frustrations.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: Seafaring is a dangerous business indeed…… Desperate Hours looks at major disasters on the high seas including the Sewol Ferry disaster in South Korea, the Ferry Estonia in the Baltic Sea, the sinking of the Titanic, the Exxon Valdez in Prince William Sound Alaska, the Express Samina in Portes Islets, pirates attacking the Maersk Alabama and Seabourn Spirit, and the Costa Concordia in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller…… Airplane crashes are most people’s worst nightmares. Desperate Hours looks at major disasters in aviation history including Malaysia Airlines MH17 and MH370, Air France Flight 447, Germanwings Flight 9525, the Tenerife airport disaster, the Challenger and Columbia space shuttle disasters, the 2015 Sumatra Indonesian Air Force C-130 crash, the 1997 Irkutsk Antonov An-124 crash, and the Concorde Flight 4590 crash.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Buckle up and stay vigilant…… Desperate Hours looks at road and train accidents including the Spanish train accident in Santiago De Compostella, a road accident in Pakistan, an oil truck crash in Nigeria that killed 96 people, the Queen of the Sea train accident in Sri Lanka, accidents caused by fog in Italy and the UK, an one hundred vehicle accident on the A1 Motorway in Austria, a road accident in Mexico, and an Amtrak accident in the United States.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Better safe than sorry…… Desperate Hours takes a look at the Kyoto Protocol and the danger of rising sea levels. The programme looks at the causes of environmental disasters including landfill waste, the great Pacific Garbage Patch, oil spills, air pollution, and the destruction of the rain forest as well as the destructive effects of environmental disasters including ozone depletion and rising temperatures in the arctic.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E01 - A Family Affair
programme.desc: In the remote corners of the Alaskan bush country are bounties unlike any other. Rugged, raw and now cooked - this is the last culinary frontier where one chef is redefining what it means to eat like a wild man. Finicky clients, bi-polar weather changes, and food and supply shortages often push Bradley to the last ounce of his sanity but this creative, free-spirit always seems to deliver.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E02 - Surfers' Delight
programme.desc: In the Planet's ultimate test kitchen this episode serves up a special dinner for a group of surfers but there is a storm coming. This will be one to remember. On the menu a mixed green salad with a raspberry vinaigrette, whitefish gelatine with cucumber and corn relish following by seared halibut and polenta.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E03 - Hunters Paradise
programme.desc: Catering off the grid isn't easy and the Ewing Family knows it. A group of 8 hunters will be served a beet salad followed by braised venison and for desert cheesecake with lingonberries.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E04 - Celebration
programme.desc: Another 5 Star meal from the Ewing Family. This time it is a dinner for some local natives. Bradley decides to go on a hunt for a goat for the first course of slow braised goat ragout, followed by a fish risotto, and for the main course - curried goat with apple and rose hip chutney and to complete the dinner a chocolate molten lava cake for desert.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.
